auditDegraded: The effective configuration switched, but the audit history was not written: {error}

status.dirty: The draft is unsaved; the effective configuration has not changed.
status.unchanged: Saved; the content matches the effective configuration, so no new effective entry was added.
status.synced: The draft matches the effective configuration.
status.failed: Saving or applying failed; the effective configuration has not changed.

conflict: The configuration file was changed externally. Reload and merge the draft; neither the draft nor the effective configuration was overwritten.
invalid: Configuration validation failed, nothing was saved: {errors}
rejected: Applying the configuration failed, nothing took effect: {error}

issue.configNotObject: The configuration must be an object.
issue.configFormatUnknown: Unknown configuration format; the file was not loaded.
issue.configFormatDeclaration: format must be a nonempty string.
issue.configFormatRetired: The configuration format "{format}" was retired; this build reads only {current} and does not convert old rules.
issue.ruleFormatRetired: The rule still uses the retired single-condition "{field}" shape; rewrite it with conditions.
issue.typeStringArray: Must be an array of strings.
issue.typeAgentScope: Must be a nonempty array of strings.
issue.reviewerUrlRequired: A decision backend requires a URL.
issue.reviewerCredentialRequired: A decision backend requires a credential reference.
issue.reviewerModelRequired: A decision backend requires a model.
issue.reviewerModelMismatch: The endpoint serves a different model than the configured one.
issue.ruleShadowed: Rule "{allow}" may be shadowed by the force-review rule "{review}".
issue.ruleAgentsEmpty: The agent scope must not be an empty list.
issue.ruleIdEmpty: The rule ID must not be empty.
issue.rulePatternEmpty: The match expression must not be empty.
issue.ruleConditionsEmpty: Each rule needs at least one match condition.
issue.rulePatternType: This match kind needs a string expression; numbers, booleans and null are only used for exact matching.
issue.rulePathRequired: An argument condition requires a JSONPath.
issue.rulePathScope: JSONPath only applies to tool argument conditions.
issue.ruleMultiScope: "any / all" only applies to tool argument conditions.
issue.ruleMultiValue: "any / all" must be any or all.
issue.ruleNameEmpty: The custom name must not be empty.
issue.ruleToolsEmpty: The tool scope must not be an empty list.
issue.ruleToolEmpty: A name in the tool scope must not be empty.
issue.ruleCombineRequired: A rule with several conditions must state how they combine (combine: all or any).
issue.ruleUnknownField: Unknown field "{field}": it has no effect, and the rule keeps the meaning it declares.
